subject: design/installed-authoring-contracts
statement: Checked-in guides, policy documents, and templates keep source-runnable commands and Pyxis source-contract paths. Release staging renders only their payload copies to the installed pyxis command grammar, shipped template paths, and release-pinned .pyxis/reference snapshots, refusing missing cited contracts or templates.
intent: Keep source development and installed Argus and direct skills runnable in their respective repositories.
rationale: Source checkouts need no released pyxis binary on PATH; installed repositories have neither the engine command source nor Pyxis source contracts. Direct skills also read routing policy and templates transitively.
fit_criterion: Release tests prove source files are unchanged, staged direct and transitive guides use installed commands and paths, contract snapshots match source, and missing references refuse packaging.
